info.name: Find publications by merchant and store or postal/zip code

params.name: merchant_identifier
params.description: Your merchant name identifier which can be obtained from your Flipp technical contact.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Contact your Flipp technical contact for your API access token.

params.name: locale
params.description:
Providing a locale will return content from that locale's language whenever Flipp has that content available. Content includes the underlying circular, as well as categories.
When localized content is not available for a given locale, an empty response is returned.
| Locale              | Description                                               |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| en-CA               | English, Canada                                           |
| fr-CA               | French, Canada                                            |
| en-US               | English, United States                                    |

params.name: store_code
params.description: Retailer's store code.

params.name: postal_code
params.description: Optional if store_code is provided. Values can be a Canadian postal code, or a United States zipcode.

params.name: see_future
params.description: Whether to include future publications in the results. Requires special access token permissions.

params.name: show_storefronts
params.description: Show Digital Content. If true will suppress publications that are not optimized for vertical scroll. If false will suppress digital only content. Default is false.

items.docs: Returns a list of available publications for a given store and optionally postal/zip code. Publications are selected using the supplied store's location. The validity dates of a publication specify the period for which the content (sales, pricing, etc.) is valid. The availability dates specify the time that the publication should be accessible within an application.The sort order depends on order that should be manually set up on 'Flyers sorting' tab in Fadmin

params.name: publication_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the publication.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Contact your Flipp technical contact for your API access token.

items.docs: Returns the list of pages in the given publication.The width of the thumbnails in the response may vary to preserve image aspect ratios.

params.name: publication_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the publication.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Contact your Flipp technical contact for your API access token.

items.docs: Returns the list of highlights in the given publication. Highlights are special tags given to items which allow them to be highlighted on the front end by darkening the surrounding items/areas of the publication. For example, some merchants like all items made in the USA to be given a "Made in USA" highlight.

params.name: publication_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the publication.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Contact your Flipp technical contact for your API access token.

items.docs: Returns the list of categories in the given publication. The categories can be used to implement a feature that jumps to a specific category in the publication. For example, if the publication has a grocery section, then the grocery category would be used to scroll to the start of the grocery section.

params.name: publication_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the publication.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Contact your Flipp technical contact for your API access token.

params.name: page
params.description: Limit products to those appearing on a specified page in the circular.

params.name: display_type
params.description:
Comma-delimited list of integers specifying types of circular items to return.
If not provided, this endpoint will only return items with a display type of 1.
See table below for a list of display types.
| Display Type Number | Description                                               |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1                   | Circular item                                             |
| 3                   | Video (YouTube embedded URL or link to mp4 file)          |
| 5                   | Web linkout (link to external site)                       |
| 7                   | Circular page link (link to another page in the circular) |
| 15                  | iframe (displays a URL in an iframe)                      |
| 25                  | Coupon (retailer coupon displayed as a circular item)     |
| all                 | All items regardless of type                              |

params.name: postal_code
params.description: Postal/zip code to specify the region from which to fetch coupons.

params.name: store_code
params.description: Store code required for deep_link of the product.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Comma-delimited list of keywords appearing in item names/descriptions with which to filter items.

params.name: tags
params.description: Text strings that allow items to be filtered based on more detailed groupings/categorizations. Ask your Flipp Technical contact for more details on how to provide tags against your items.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Return items sorted by a specified criterion. Supported sort criteria are listed in the table below.
| Sort criterion      | Description                                               |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| popularity          | Orders items based on the running total of clicks that
shoppers have made on the items in the current circular.
Item click counts are updated at least twice per day.
                                 |

params.name: sort_order
params.description:
When used with sort_by, determines the order in which items are sorted by the specified criterion.
| Sort order          | Description                                               |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| asc                 | Sort items in ascending order.                            |
| desc                | Sort items in descending order (default).                 |

params.name: category
params.description: Filter products by given category.

params.name: size
params.description: Set the count of products to be returned. Positive number. All products will be returned if size >= total products count and offset = 0 or missing. [] is returned if there are no products available.

params.name: offset
params.description: Set the count of items to be skipped when size parameter is specified. 0 is a default value. [] is returned if offset is too big.

items.docs: For a given publication ID, returns a list of products in the publication. The products in the response are sorted by position, from first page to last, then top to bottom, then left to right by default.Text will be localized according to the locale of the publication. If keywords or tags are provided, a maximum of 1000 items will be returned.
